title: Stops (v0)
description: Tour stop structure. Shipped as stops.json at the bundle root. The tracker is the eventual source of truth (ADR 0001) but coordinate ownership transitions post-launch (ADR 0009). For v0: the app retains stop ownership; coordinates remain app-side and stay OUT of the v0 bundle. Stop names are translated in locale files under 'stop.<stop_id>.name'.

stop_id.description: Stable lowercase slug. Example: 'hospital_santa_creu'. Per ADR 0009, this is the cross-system identity — all references to a stop (filenames, locale keys, coordinate associations) use stop_id, not numeric position.

stop_number.description: 1-based tour position. May skip values if a stop is removed.

stop_type.description: 'listening' = a physical stop the user stands at (will eventually get coordinates, arrival detection, a map pin); 'walking' = transition narration that plays between two listening stops (no GPS pin, triggered by app on departure/arrival/etc.). Internal-only buckets like 'general' (cross-stop image holding pen) exist in the tracker but never ship in the bundle.

default_name.description: Fallback display name when no translation is available. Usually English.

lat.description: Decimal degrees. App-owned through v0 per ADR 0009 — tracker MAY emit known values as reference, but the app's tour JSON remains authoritative until post-launch migration. App ignores this field through v0. Flat structure (not nested) matches Emily's Stop.swift model.

lng.description: Decimal degrees. Same ownership and consumption rules as lat.

scene_ids.description: Scene IDs belonging to this stop, in narrative order. The app uses this to render the stop detail view.

appendix_image_filenames.description: Filenames (in /images/) for this stop's appendix photos, in display order. Filenames follow ADR 0011 (slug-based).

x-removed-from-v0.arrival_radius_meters: Proximity tuning interacts with GPS accuracy, map camera, and on-device testing — it's an app concern (ADR 0009). Permanently app-owned. NOT a v0 contract field.
